name: cc-safety-net
description: A pre-execution guard for AI coding agents. It blocks destructive Git and file system commands, plus common attempts to access sensitive files, before a tool call runs. Supports Amp Code, Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Devin CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Kimi Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode, and Pi.

capability_evidence.auto-failover: mands and access to secrets such as SSH keys and .env files before the tool call runs.
capability_evidence.agent-runtime: tallation, configuration, reference material, guides, and the security model.
capability_evidence.gui-desktop: ks secret access to SSH keys, .env files, ~/.aws, and coding-CLI credentials, from the shell and from the agent's file tools.
capability_evidence.cross-agent-support: Mentions Amp, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot

highlights: Embeds in your own tools. Call checkCommand from Node.js without installing the hook. See Library API.
Shares policy through git. Commit .cc-safety-net/ so clones and cloud sessions get the same rules. See Team setup.
Blocks secret access to SSH keys, .env files, ~/.aws, and coding-CLI credentials, from the shell and from the agent's file tools.
